chemistry-m1-c.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-m1-c.material: [Isantya sokusasazeka esinzulu] Kumacala omabini ombhobho omde weglasi kwafakwa ukotini ofakwe kwi-ammonia egxininisiweyo (ubunzima beemolekyuli 17) nokotini ofakwe kwi-hydrochloric acid egxininisiweyo (ubunzima beemolekyuli 36.5) ngaxeshanye, yaza yavalwa ngezivalo zerabha. Emva kwexesha elifutshane kwavela ibhanti lomsi omhlophe (i-ammonium chloride) ngaphakathi kombhobho, ngaphakathi kwendawo eyiphi ekwi-ammonia okanye ekwi-hydrochloric acid ebinakuyimeli ngakumbi?

Emva kwexesha elifutshane kwavela ibhanti lomsi omhlophe (i-ammonium chloride) ngaphakathi kombhobho, ngaphakathi kwendawo eyiphi ekwi-ammonia okanye ekwi-hydrochloric acid ebinakuyimeli ngakumbi?
chemistry-m1-c.s.s1.explain: Isantya sokusasazeka kwegesi singqamene ngokungeyomfuneko nengcambu yesikwere yobunzima beemolekyuli. Igesi ye-ammonia elula, enobunzima beemolekyuli be-17, ihamba ngokukhawuleza kakhulu kunegesi ye-hydrogen chloride enzima (36.5), ngoko impendulo yenzeka kwindawo esondele kokotini we-hydrochloric acid ohamba kancinci ukwenza ibhanti lomsi omhlophe.

chemistry-killer-07.title: I-mole
chemistry-killer-07.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-07.material: Kubushushu noxinzelelo olusemgangathweni (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol yegesi = 22.4 L), ingxubevange yegesi ye-methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) kunye ne-carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) inomthamo we-11.2 L kunye nobunzima be-16.4 g. Ubunzima beeathom ngu-H = 1, C = 12, O = 16, kwaye inani lika-Avogadro yi-$N_A$. Zingaphi iiathom zizonke kule ngxubevange?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: Kubushushu noxinzelelo olusemgangathweni (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol yegesi = 22.4 L), ingxubevange yegesi ye-methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) kunye ne-carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) inomthamo we-11.2 L kunye nobunzima be-16.4 g. Ubunzima beeathom ngu-H = 1, C = 12, O = 16, kwaye inani lika-Avogadro yi-$N_A$. Zingaphi iiathom zizonke kule ngxubevange?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Iimoli zizonke = 11.2 L / 22.4 L/mol = 0.5 mol, ngoko x + y = 0.5.
Inyathelo 2: Ubunzima: 16x + 44y = 16.4. Faka y = 0.5 - x: 16x + 22 - 44x = 16.4, ngoko 28x = 5.6, x = 0.2, y = 0.3.
Inyathelo 3: Iiathom: $\mathrm{CH_4}$ ineeathom ezi-5 kwimolekyuli nganye, 0.2 x 5 = 1.0 mol; $\mathrm{CO_2}$ ineeathom ezi-3, 0.3 x 3 = 0.9 mol. Iyonke 1.9 mol yeeathom = $1.9\,N_A$.
Iimpendulo: $1.9\,N_A$ (c). (Ezinye ezingachanekanga: i-1.5 ithatha yonke i-CO2, i-2.5 ithatha yonke i-CH4, i-1.7 ibala iiathom ezi-4 kuphela kwi-CH4.)
chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
